A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]''' was employed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. He was a guard on the first [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], where he was killed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] jumped back on the skiff. He was slashed by the lightsaber and fell off of the skiff and into the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]], where he was eaten alive.

==Behind the scenes==
The Weequay was played by stuntman [[Julius LeFlore]].<ref name="Actor">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2014/09/behind-scenes-just-another-day-at-skiff.html|name=STAR WARS AFICIONADO WEBSITE|text=Behind the Scenes: Just Another Day at the Skiff!}}</ref> When the Weequay falls off the skiff, the [[Wilhelm scream]] can be heard.

[[Hasbro]] released an action figure based on this [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] named "Weequay Skiff Master" in [[2011]] for their ''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]'' line.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#048: Weequay (Skiff Master)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVC48Weequay.asp}}</ref>
